text:
Riley: getting reports that the sample app fails on newer Next edge builds: "Cannot find module 'redwood-js-sdk'" at deploy time.
Noah: is this the pnpm+yarn2 case or plain npm?
Riley: customer on pnpm, but reproduced with npm in our CI too. Local node dev works.
Sasha: classic exports resolution ambiguity. If we ship main->cjs and module->esm but no `exports` field, packagers can pick the wrong entry.
Adie: agreed. conditional `exports` is the only way to be explicit for node/bundlers/edge. e.g.:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs" },
  "./edge": "./dist/esm/edge-entry.mjs"
}
```
Noah: +1 but note: don't put `types` inside `exports`. Keep top-level "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts" for TS. Some toolchains don't honor `types` in `exports` yet.
Sasha: second problem: our ESM edge entry currently re-exports a helper that pulls in `node:crypto` sync APIs. Edge environments crash.
Riley: that explains the failure only on edge. Any short-term unblock for onboarding?
Adie: add a tiny `edge-entry.mjs` that only uses web-safe apis and delegates core logic to a shared `dist/auth/core.mjs` which must be isomorphic. Then update sample to import `redwood-js-sdk/edge` when running in edge.
Noah: we should avoid duplicating auth/retry logic between bundles. Right now build produces two monolithic bundles and the retry behavior drifted (setImmediate vs setTimeout) causing 401s to not retry on edge.
Sasha: refactor plan: export `src/auth/core.ts` as a standalone artifact. Mark it external in bundler so both `dist/esm/index.mjs` and `dist/cjs/index.cjs` import `./auth/core.*`. Keep only one implementation and polyfill timing with a tiny helper that uses `globalThis.setImmediate ?? ((fn)=>setTimeout(fn,0))`.
Riley: good. I'll open the onboarding PR that patches the sample to runtime-detect and import the edge path:
```js
const isEdge = typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' && !!globalThis.fetch && process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME === 'edge';
const sdk = await import(isEdge ? 'redwood-js-sdk/edge' : 'redwood-js-sdk');
```
Adie: also add a small note in README about subpath `/edge` and recommend ESM imports for edge deployments.
Noah: CI changes: add a devex/edge-smoke job that runs `wrangler dev` and `vercel dev` smoke tests against the sample. Catch regressions on PRs.
Sasha: build pipeline change: switch from bundling-auth-into-every-output to externalizing `auth/core` and generate `dist/types/index.d.ts` that re-exports types only. Add a dts rollup step to avoid references to cjs internals.
Riley: can someone check pnpm oddities? I think pnpm's hoisting + conditional exports can lead to different resolution when `exports` absent.
Adie: I'll run pnpm + npm + yarn in matrix CI once the exports patch lands. Also add a lint rule to fail if any ESM entry imports `node:` builtins. That would have caught the `node:crypto` regression.
publish-bot: queued job devex/edge-smoke/sample-runner for branch/PRs.
Riley: thanks team — plan: Adie -> exports + edge-entry PR, Sasha -> auth/core externalization + typings, Noah -> CI smoke, me -> sample + README. We'll reconvene after PR review. :rocket:
